entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I... I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into a return for you. To get started, could you tell me your name and the item you're calling about?
My name is Sarah Miller. It's about the pair of cycling shoes I bought.

Okay, Sarah, I have your account pulled up. I see the order for the cycling shoes. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a fit and preference issue?

It's the fit, I guess. I've tried everything. I adjusted the cleats multiple times, I've worn different socks... but every time I ride, I get terrible blisters on my heels. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I just feel so let down. I saved up for these.

Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and I completely understand your frustration. I can see you received the item about 60 days ago. Let me just confirm the return policy for you.
Okay... I just really hope you can help. I really needed this money back for some other things.

Of course. And... good news. Our policy for standard gear like these cycling shoes allows for returns up to 10 days after delivery. Since you're unfortunately outside that timeframe, I can absolutely authorize a full refund for you.
Oh, really? A full refund? That is such a relief. Thank you so, so much, Alex. You have no idea what a help that is.

You are very welcome, Sarah. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on your account right now. Just box up the shoes, attach the label, and drop them off. Once our warehouse scans them in, your refund will be processed automatically.
That's perfect. I'll get that sent out this afternoon. Thank you again for being so helpful.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
